subject: Bespoke bars and entertaining furniture
hook: A home bar is more than a shelf of bottles. Five decisions make it work when the guests arrive.
ig:
A home bar is more than a shelf of bottles. Five decisions make it work when the guests arrive.

If you are thinking about a bespoke home bar before the hosting season, start here:

1. The spot. Alcoves, under-stairs spaces and dining-room corners all work well. Keep it near where people gather, but out of the main walkway.
2. Your bottles. Measure the tallest ones and your favourite glasses. Adjustable shelves cover the rest.
3. Power. A drinks fridge or lighting needs a socket in the right place, set by your electrician before anything is fitted.
4. The top. Matt and super matt finishes are more forgiving of fingerprints than gloss.
5. Hidden storage. Mixers, spare glasses and multipacks live behind doors, so the display stays tidy.

Plan these five and the bar looks good on a quiet Tuesday and works on a busy Saturday.

Save this for later. Our bespoke furniture is linked in bio.
